ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This online course for students in the Rockford cohort begins January 20th and ends May 12th. Course sessions will alternate between Compass only and online Elluminate classes. The online Elluminate classes will be held on Thursdays evening from 6:00 to 8:30 PM. The dates for the online Elluminate class sessions are February 3 and 17, March 3 and 31 and April 14. In addition to the online Elluminate sessions, there will also be three face-to-face classes held at the College of Medicine in Rockford in room E-120. The Thursday face-to-face classes will be held from 6:00 to 8:30 PM on January 20, March 17 & April 28. Compass is the university?s course management system and Elluminate is the conferencing technology used to deliver synchronous online classes sessions. The email address for the instructor is: dcrowell@illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $423.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
